_units: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. A non-zero count in a unit with no numeric price makes the dollar cost of the call unknown (cost_usd null) and the runner refuses to start a caching phase.
_source: Anthropic pricing page, checked 2026-10-14, first-party. Prompts up to 100K input tokens (input + cache writes + cache reads) use the base rates. Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100K use over_100k and apply to the whole request; stage2_cost.dollars() raises on that case, so the base rate is never misapplied.
